name: How long does attic insulation installation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does attic insulation installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of attic insulation installation depends on the size and accessibility of your attic, the type of insulation being installed, and whether old insulation needs to be removed. For an average-sized home with straightforward access, a new insulation installation can typically be completed within one day. If old insulation removal is required, or if the attic has complex access points, the project might extend to two days. Your contractor can provide a more precise timeline after assessing your attic.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most attic insulation installations take one to two days, depending on attic size, accessibility, insulation type, and if old insulation needs removal.
